name: ART 3665
title: Ceramics: Clay and Glaze Composition
description: Advanced studio investigations exploring clay and glaze formulation and function, as means to technical control and creative discovery in ceramic art practice. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: ART 2610 and one 3000-level Ceramics course from ART 3605, 3610, 3615, 3620, 3625, or 3655. Open only to Art and Art History majors, others by instructor consent
